description.value: Study for a motif, likely for a poster or advertisement. In the foreground at left, a tall brown telephone tower, with black wires extending at an angle downwards at to the right, connecting to a gray sphere at the top of a second tower in black. On top of the sphere, an American flag. To the left of the tower, an abstract depiction of the Statue of Liberty in white and gray, with star spangled clouds and red and white stripes surrounding the statue’s head. In the foreground (between the brown tower and the Statue of Liberty) a large black rectangle leaning to the left, resembling a large bollard on a dock. The background is shaded in yellow and blue.
